verdict.rationale: Background autonomy is a fair question for an agent-skills bundle, but the evidence shows no skill that schedules, triggers, or runs automations unattended. The skills are invoked interactively via slash commands, and several (TDD, grilling) require explicit user confirmation. The 'ready-for-agent' triage label for an AFK agent only prepares briefs for some other agent. Sub-agent dispatch and self-updating plugins are adjacent features and earn no credit.
